title: Bucharest shakeout (optional on short sleep)
terrain: Bucharest, flat park loop or hotel treadmill
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 07:50-08:25, 35min at 130-148bpm. Done before the 09:00 Vlad call.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 1L water on waking, protein breakfast.
GARMIN: ~30-40.
STOP RULE: in bed after 02:00 or under 5h30 sleep = skip, nothing moves.
WHY: landing ~01:00 means a short night; this exists only to loosen legs for Wednesday's threshold.
